scenicChapters.title: Richard Russell Scenic Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 8.0%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Richard Russell Scenic Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 900 m come off over 16 km at around 5.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

suches-and-wolf-pen.story: 74 km from Dahlonega to Blairsville, about 1 h 25 of riding. It goes by way of Turners Corner and Suches. The climb of the day is Wolf Pen Gap. It tops out at 900 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
